page.overview:
What is 15 Cherrywood Road?

The Brackett residence is the household of the Brackett family, consisting of: Annie Brackett, Lee Brackett and Laurie Strode.

After the events of Halloween 2007, Lee Brackett decided to take in his daughter's friend Laurie Strode and they moved to 15 Cherrywood Road, which was on the outskirts of Haddonfield. On October 31, 2008, Lee had one of his deputies, Andy Neale, sit outside of his house to watch over the girls, since he feared another attack. Nothing much happened on that night, other than Annie kicking deputy Neale in the crotch. That same time the following year, Lee's fears would come true. On October 31, 2009, Michael Myers had returned in search of Laurie and discovered her location. He murdered Deputy Neale and Annie and Laurie's friend, Mya Rockwell. Once Lee arrived at his house, he discovered the corpses of his daughter and Mya, and that Laurie had been captured by Michael. Laurie was later sent to a mental asylum after she had gone insane from what had happened to her.
